newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -T-bonds to stage modest rally to 116-28.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -T-bonds to stage modest rally to 116-28.

text.p: September T-bond futures will make headway on Thursday, but gains will be kept in check, technical analysts said.
"The trend is strong but there are risks higher," said Mike Macdonald, technical analyst at 4CAST in London. Technical indicators were moving into overbought territory, he added.

Initial resistance for the contract lies at 116-19, Macdonald said, just above the overnight high of 116-17. The December 3 high of 116-28 on the continuation chart provides strong resistance, Macdonald said.
September T-bonds were down 1/32 at 116-11 at 0942 GMT.
Macdonald found further resistance at 116-31, a 150 percent Fibonacci projection of the downmove on the daily chart from the high of 113-09 on February 18 to the 105-30 low on April 11.
"Above there, 117-26 is a 1.618 projection," he added.
According to Deutsche Morgan Grenfell analysts T-bonds may ease before pulling back.
"We should hold 115-27 to remain positive. A dip to 116-09/03 looks possible here, but further gains toward the low/mid 117s look likely," they said in a note to clients.
The 115-27 level provides minor support on intraday charts, Macdonald said.
Just below there, Wednesday's low of 115-26 acts as a safety net.
Lower still, 115-10 offers rising trendline support, Macdonald said.
December Eurodollars also have upside potential, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said.
"Though the market is overbought, we still do not have a sell signal, and wave counts suggest that the risk is to the higher end of that range."
December Eurodollars stood 0.005 higher on the day at 94.190.
